text:
Andrew: Quick thought — want to float a compact private-offer structure for the HW+marketplace bundle that smooths renewals and keeps SI margins intact.
Maya: curious — smoothing how? quarterly ramp or blended rate? :thinking_face:
Andrew: blended committed bucket over 12 months, with quarterly true-ups. idea is commit = credits usable for hosted + dedicated. HW credits applied at redemption time.
Sarah: from sales POV we need predictable discounting tiers. customers/partners always ask what happens at renewal.
Leo: finance prefers a decaying overage price rather than big true-ups. less churn in revenue recognition.
Maya: propose tiers: 0-250k -> 18% marketplace discount + hw credit 5%; 250k-1M -> 25% + hw 8%; 1M+ -> 32% + hw 12%. tier step-ups on annual commitments.
Claire: SI impact? SIs need an attachable services credit so they still get paid. can we carve out a services allowance from the hw credit bucket?
Andrew: yes — carve 15% of HW credit as SI services credit. they can invoice against that. keeps co-sell motion healthy.
Sarah: good. also want a renewal smoothing clause: if renew within 90 days of expiration, grandfather previous tier for 1 term if commitment within 10% of prior year. reduces churn.
Leo: we should model worst-case elasticity. can someone run a sensitivity: take a $600k commit, show revenue with and without grandfathering + service carve?
Maya: will run a simple model. quick note on SKU mapping: marketplace SKUs map to commit buckets; we send private offer with SKU list + HW credit line item. keep the backend simple.
Andrew: sample private-offer payload snippet for marketplace team: 
```
{ "sku_commit_bucket": "commit-250-1M", "commit_term_months": 12, "hw_credit_amount": "48000", "si_services_credit": "7200" }
```
Maya: love it. also recommend adding a 30% utilization gate: commitments that use <30% by month 6 trigger a review call and 10% clawback if unused at term end (to avoid pure credit hoarding).
Claire: can we make that a mutual review instead of automatic clawback? SIs dislike surprise deductions.
Andrew: mutual review with a 14-day remediation window. if no remediation plan, then modest clawback.
legal-bot: FYI — require explicit language in PO: "unused credits subject to remediation and potential prorated recovery". I'll draft.
Sarah: pls tag me on the draft. Sales ops needs the exact clause for quoting.
Leo: action items: Maya -> modeling by EOD Tue; Legal -> draft clause; Claire -> SI attachment workflow; Sarah -> update sales quoting doc with grandfathering rule.
Maya: got it. I'll share numbers in #partnerships spreadsheet.
Andrew: thanks all. aim to pilot with 2 HW partners + 1 SI by next quarter. low-touch first, iterate. :thumbsup:
Claire: sounds good. will sync with partner success on onboarding checklist.
Sarah: ping me when pilot offers are ready — want to prep enablement.
Andrew: closing note — keep private-offer window short (30d) to avoid stale pricing.
Maya: noted.
